description: This PHP class defines a Drupal form for configuring regional settings such as default country, first day of the week, and default timezone within the Drupal CMS. It includes methods for constructing the form, loading default timezone values, and creating instances with dependency injection.

classes.name: RegionalForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for configuring regional settings such as country, first day of the week, and timezone.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the form with configuration and country manager dependencies.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method for creating an instance of the form with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: getFormId
methods.description: Returns the unique form ID for this regional settings form.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form array with regional settings fields including country, first day of week, and timezone.

methods.name: loadDefaultTimeZone
methods.description: Static method to load the default timezone for display, falling back to PHP's default timezone.
